The formal definition is in Chap 3.9.5.1 of the S1000D specification and in the [S1000D Issue 7 data dictionary](https://users.s1000d.org/S1000D_DD_7/Files/attributes/infoCodeVariant.xml).
:::

`infoCodeVariant` is a part of the data module code (DMC): the variant of the information code. The value is one alphanumeric character. It is written together with [`infoCode`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/info-code/). The rules are in Chap 4.3.7 of the specification.

## Elements that carry it

In the 33 XML schemas of Issue 7, 2 elements carry this attribute.

| Element | Schemas | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dmCode` | 28 | Required |
| `updateCode` | 1 | Required |

## Allowed values

The allowed values are decided by the XML schema. The default BREX (Business Rules Exchange) has no rule that lists the values of this attribute.

| Defined by | Content |
| --- | --- |
| XML schema | The type is `infoCodeVariantAttType` (based on `xs:string`). The pattern is `[A-Z0-9]{1}` |

## In this stack

| Operation | Tool |
| --- | --- |
| Read | [`list_data_modules`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/reader/list-data-modules/) and [`read_data_module`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/reader/read-data-module/). The value is returned as a part of the data module code |
| Decide it when a data module is created | `allocation.rules.infoCodeByKind` of [`build_data_module`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/writer/build-data-module/). Pass both `infoCode` and `infoCodeVariant` for each kind |
